value.title: La nave che solca i cieli
value.synopsis: Una ragazza misteriosa sta aspettando l'arrivo della nave volante che verrà a prenderla, come un viaggiatore le ha promesso in passato.

value.title: Poteri
value.synopsis: Norn is attacked by people seeking to capture and use members of the crew. When the enemy turns its weapons on the ship, Koharu releases her devastating ability to save them.

value.title: Primavera che germoglia
value.synopsis: As the others try to make sense of the attack the day before, Koharu encounters a new boy aboard the ship. With the threat of an insider, who can truly be trusted?

value.title: Serenata dell'aurora
value.synopsis: È il momento di scendere a terra a fare provviste, ma la situazione a bordo si fa caotica con l'ammalarsi di Kakeru.

value.title: La foresta sonnecchiante
value.synopsis: Seeing the girls out of sorts, Itsuki uses his ability to send them to a “dream world” with Koharu as Snow White, Mikoto as Cinderella, and Nanami is Red Riding Hood!

value.title: L'ingranaggio ha iniziato a muoversi
value.synopsis: The entire crew is still reeling from the effects of last night's strange dream. Just as things couldn’t get more uncomfortable, the ship is attacked again… from the inside.

value.title: Un sogno della realtà
value.synopsis: With the journey ending soon, the crew decides to have fun with a dare contest. However, wounded hearts and hidden intentions threaten the safety of everyone on the ship.

value.title: Mondo
value.synopsis: Mikoto’s been kidnapped, and Sakuya, Masaume, and the others launch a search. With war on the horizon, they are forced to learn the truth about their world’s dark history.

value.title: Le verità di ognuno
value.synopsis: With Koharu still missing, Kakeru returns to the surface to find her and his father. Meanwhile, Akito and Nanami prepare to reveal their secret to a member of the ship.

value.title: Aion - Eternità
value.synopsis: Everything changed when Koharu joined the crew of Norn. The sins of the past forge an uncertain future and put the fate of the crew, and the world itself, in the balance.

value.title: Reset
value.synopsis: Following Sakuya’s vision of the near future, the crew hurries to rescue Koharu and Mikoto. On the island, Kakeru runs into Natsuhiko and Ron.

value.title: Nuovo mondo
value.synopsis: The group is finally reunited aboard the ship. The Reset weighs heavily on their minds, and Koharu fears the inevitable global consequences of their decision.
